smb_merge_rule: SMB-1.pcap and SMB-2.pcap are two source captures of one logical class SMB
class_selection_rule: Reuse fixed Open-Detect USTC A-1/A-2/A-3 lists by class name; never translate by numeric ID and never reselect from results

sample_split_rule.known_train: source train rows restricted to Known classes
sample_split_rule.known_validation: source val rows restricted to Known classes
sample_split_rule.known_final_test: source test rows restricted to Known classes
sample_split_rule.unknown_final_test: source test rows restricted to held-out Unknown classes

unknown_free_constraints: No Unknown class in encoder training
No Unknown class in encoder validation or checkpoint selection
No Unknown class in scaler fitting
No Unknown class in PCA fitting
No Unknown class in Gaussian/GMM fitting
No Unknown class in K selection
No Unknown class in threshold calibration
No Unknown class in hyperparameter tuning
Unknown is loaded only for Final Test
Each scenario retrains a Known-only encoder
The existing 20-class Open-Detect checkpoint is diagnosis-only

primary_metrics.unknown_positive_definition: Unknown is positive; Known is negative
metrics: Unknown TPR at 95% Known Validation acceptance
primary_metrics.comparison: Single-Full vs Multi-Full-K2 at matched 95% Known Validation acceptance
primary_metrics.uncertainty: paired class-stratified bootstrap 95% CI on frozen final-test predictions

support_models.name: Single-Full
support_models.model: one full-covariance Gaussian per Known class

support_models.name: Multi-Full-K2
support_models.model: fixed K=2 full-covariance GMM per Known class

protocol_sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 of jq -Sc canonical JSON after deleting protocol_sha256
